title: TerraPreserve: a benchmark of labelled Terraform remediation scenarios
description: TerraPreserve is a benchmark dataset for evaluating whether a Terraform repair preserves the invariants that the original configuration already satisfied. It contains 320 labelled remediation scenarios in 8 change families (416 scenarios with reserves and exclusions), labelled per step by a separately implemented, plan-based oracle. This release includes the 128 test-split scenarios and the oracle labels of the test LLM candidates, byte for byte as frozen at terrapreserve-v1.0. Companion dataset to DAIL (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24495207). Code: Apache-2.0; scenarios and labels: CC-BY-4.0; TerraDS-derived files keep their source licences.
